checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Same pose, face, hoodie, tail, and proportions.

must.item: Retains orange hoodie and friendly look
must.why: Hoodie is recolored salmon pink and fur is pink; the friendly face is kept but the hoodie is no longer orange.
Ears to boots and tail all visible.
Pink-to-teal sky, striped sun, grid floor, neon outline.

faults.what: Hoodie and fur shifted from orange to pink/salmon, so the 'keep the orange hoodie' request is only weakly met; pants changed from blue to teal.
Striped sun is mostly hidden behind the fox's head and looks cropped.
Small stray teal marks at left edge of sky.

summary: The output is a faithful vaporwave restyle with the full fox, neon glow, grid and sun, but the orange hoodie turned salmon-pink, which weakens the 'keep the orange hoodie' requirement.
